gate3.note: No new core filter or entry rule was added. The pressure resilience candidate source is additive default-off paper, so core signals generated/survived are unchanged from baseline.

gate_questions.1_alpha_hypothesis: entry/candidate_pool: official macro relief days may create cleaner leadership continuation because a macro uncertainty release can force fast risk reallocation into the day's strongest liquid stocks.

2_history_check.exp-20260525-901: Opening-range macro-confirmed gate improved EV only +0.2926 and had one PnL-regression window; rejected.
2_history_check.exp-20260605-030/032: NFP and scheduled macro selloff QQQ actions were too thin and failed strict materiality; this test is a stock candidate pool, not ETF beta allocation.
2_history_check.exp-20260606-004/005: Broad 5-day winner continuation was positive but rejected for drawdown/tail and old_thin weakness; this test only admits official macro relief dates.

gate_questions.4_acceptance_standard: Use docs/backtesting.md three canonical windows. Aggregate EV/PnL must improve, at least two windows must improve, target sample >=12 across all 3 windows, survival >=5%, drawdown drift <=0.5pp, and concentration guard must pass.

hypothesis: Official CPI/FOMC/NFP relief days where SPY and QQQ both rally and close strong may identify stock leaders with cleaner 10-trading-day next-open replacement value than broad daily momentum.
interpretation: The official macro relief leadership candidate pool did not clear Gate 4. Do not promote or retune this macro-relief stock leadership definition on the frozen windows without materially new PIT macro surprise/consensus data or forward replacement-value evidence.
negative_reflection: If rejected, the likely reason is that official macro relief dates are a thin sample and the selected stocks are still a broad momentum relabeling. A retry would need a true PIT macro surprise/consensus field or forward replacement-value evidence, not threshold retuning.
next_evidence_needed: A retry needs a real PIT macro-surprise/consensus field or closed forward replacement-value rows; do not simply retune relief returns, close-location thresholds, hold days, cooldown, or paper notional.

production_impact.parity_note: This experiment changes no production code. A positive result would require a shared default-off adapter exposing the same official CPI/FOMC/NFP calendar, SPY/QQQ relief-day test, sector-known liquid stock universe, stock leadership fields, same-ticker core-overlap exclusion, next-open paper entry, 10-trading-day exit, costs, cooldown, and concentration controls in both replay and daily production before any report queue, paper ledger, candidate priority, sizing, watchlist, or order surface could change.
